gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Angular and futuristic, Megrim draws every stroke at one hairline thickness, like fine rope. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri then settles into text with short ascenders and a tall middle band, easy to keep reading.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Futuristic and angular, Megrim gives diagonals and uprights the same stout width, made for display. Noto Sans Syriac is the one for text, its tall lowercase bowls swelling like blown glass bulbs.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-syriac-eastern: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern has tall lowercase and small caps together. Its curve endings never crowd each other, so paragraphs of text move smoothly below the angular Megrim heading.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-syriac-western: A tube-like, constant-width stroke gives Megrim its angular, futuristic edge. And Noto Sans Syriac Western feels modern and clean beside it, terminals held far from the stroke body.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with the flat line of a fineliner on paper. And Noto Sans Tagalog keeps its middle zone dominant, with curve gaps that stay generous.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Megrim never shifts its strokes from heavy to light, so it makes a crisp display face. And Noto Sans Tai Le is the text specialist, with strokes that taper out before touching.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplement: Megrim looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width, angular and futuristic. And Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, with its tall middle band, can stay modest in size.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-tc: A smooth, tube-like line gives Megrim its futuristic angles. Megrim is built to announce, while Noto Sans TC is built to read, with curves that open outward instead of curling in.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-thai: Angular and futuristic, Megrim draws bowls and stems at the same weight while Noto Sans Thai swells into rounded, glassy lowercase. Sharp angles meet inflated beads, and that tension is the draw.
gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Rope-thin lines, sharp corners: Megrim looks drawn in a single hairline outline. Noto Sans Ugaritic meets it with almost no step between lowercase and capital height, its open mouths like chalk arcs left unjoined.
